title: Revel Nail Dip Powder Starter Kit
description: ['The kit will contain the following items:15 ml (or 0.5 OZ) of Step #1 Probase']
all_reviews_text:
I like it and don't like it. I guess I just need practice. [SEP] Revel Dip Nail kit is fantastic quality at a reasonable price. I love the process of applying Dip nails. It is quick and easy. However I was really sad to discover that I’m allergic to it. All winter long I was having health problems and severe breathing issues. Which started right around the time I began doing dip nails. I took a month break from doing my nails and all my symptoms left. To test my theory I tried using the dip powder again just recently, and confirmed that indeed I am severely allergic to one of the ingredients. Pretty bummed. But it happens. For people that are not sensitive to chemicals this nail system is great. [SEP] This is the best dip powder set ever. So easy to use. Hands down, I give them a 5 out of 5. Customer service is fantastic!! Will be ordering more [SEP] Color I order was slightly different than picture but still looked good when applied. Will order more polishes in the future [SEP] I have always coveted long nails, but with weak, bendy nails that peal and break easily it was never achievable. I'm a DIY girl when it comes to nails. I have been doing my own gel manicures for years and most recently have been using Brisa lite smoothing gel for added strength. It helped but manicures still started chipping at the 10 day mark and as soon as my nails got to the desired length they would start breaking.
By comparison this stuff is amazing! Its all the strength without the bulk of regular acrylic. They are my real nails but nothing will break them.The process itself is faster since you don't have to cure for two minutes each time. The coats between and after powder are just thin glue. Its also more forgiving as the coats are all even and solidly applied. You buff and clean up in the middle of the process which makes everything even and your edges perfect. I've also filed and such after they are done without issue.
I actually ordered from Revel itself, but read the reviews here first. Revel colors are also cheaper then gel's options, with a one ounce jar of color only costing about $8. One ounce jar is probably like 8-10 manicures. Sure beats paying a salon $40 every two weeks.
Removal is slightly different. I use the cotton ball with nail caps method and find it slightly more time consuming then gel, but I think that's only because I'm still getting used to it. When exposed to acetone the dip turns into a chewed gum consistency. So unlike my CND shellac that peals off I'm rubbing off sticky blobs. But I also probably just need to try soaking it an extra 5 minutes and stop being impatient.
But the extra removal time is totally worth it when you consider the manicures last longer, are stronger, and allow me to finally have my dream long nails. [SEP] I purchased my starter kit directly from Revel, plus an extra color. Since I rely on reviews from Amazon, I'm including mine to help others.
My colors are the first photo-Shady and Starburst.
My first attempt was with Shady and I did a great job on my left hand, but didn't smooth out the right enough. It held up well, but I only got a week out of it because I couldn't deal with the bad job I'd done on my right hand.
The second photo is the second time I did my nails and first time I used Starburst. Glitter is more forgiving. I realized that with two coats of the color, you could still see the white of my nail through it. The second time I used this color, I used a white base (Fresh Cotton from Sally's). This second time is the grid photo with the purple/silver.

From start to finish (with bare nails) this takes about 45 minutes.

Advice:
1-Watch YouTube tutorials. All systems have different instructions, so they might not all apply to your kit. Keep that in mind as you watch them.
2-Let the dip dry before you brush off the excess. I didn't do that before, but employed that advice my third time (purple/silver photo) and it was a better experience.
3-Don't do this without a good buffer. A plain old nail file ain't gonna cut it!
4-I bought nail clips to hold the acetone-soaked cotton on my nails and it works way better than foil. I can do all my nails at once.
5-Before stating dip polish, after washing hands, wipe nails with alcohol pad. It gets all the oils off your nails. This is good advice for regular polish, too. [SEP] Very happy with results! Just have to follow the instructions. It's easy once you get the hang of it! And it's amazing how durable it is. I can go nearly 3 weeks between applications. I'm hard on my nails and I have almost no breakage with this. [SEP] So the directions were simple- the shipping was fast- the product seemed to do its job if you followed directions- only thing is the color is more brown than pictured.. I will post a pic I got #115

title: Aesfee Makeup Mirror Vanity Mirror with Lights, 1x/2x/3x Magnification LED Lighted Trifold Cosmetic Mirrors, 3 Color Lighting Modes Touch Control Dimmable Countertop Illuminated Mirrors - White
all_reviews_text:
In my guest bathroom, I have a nice mirror with lights, but it isn't movable and it doesn't have magnification or a change in the light to reflect white, warm and evening. This requires 4 AAA batteries. But it also comes with a charging cord, so you can put that in a USB outlet or charger and not use the batteries at all. [SEP] This mirror really wants to be elegant looking. It has a pearlized finish with some elegant swirls at the top, but it really just looks like a plastic vanity mirror that should come with one of the Barbie mannequin heads that little girls put makeup on and do their hair.
The mirror has three light settings, bright white, really yellow, and I'm assuming a daylight, which is the only light I can somewhat see myself a little bit with it on. Really, it's just awful trying to see in this mirror with the light on. This is the first lighted mirror that I've experienced this with. For some reason, the light seems to shadow your face somehow, or either it's just the wrong color or brightness, and you can hardly see yourself in the mirror at all. And, no matter which mirror I want to look in, I have to pick the mirror up and bring it close to my face. And even then, I feel like I'm looking at light, and not my face being brightened by the light.
Also, once put together, the fold out mirrors do not stay flush when folded in. It gives it the look like you've broken it and are just living with it like that. And, I find the fold out mirrors very cumbersome to look at myself in them, with the light on or off. Especially the bottom one that has the most magnification, which really should have been on the top, in my opinion. If I don't pick it up, I have to bend way down to see in the bottom one, and then I can only see half of my face if the light is on. The other half is in a shadow, whether the light is on or off. The upper mirror is just as hard to see in, as my face is shadowed on one side very heavily if the light is on. It's just an awkward design.
This mirror seemed somewhat good in theory, but because of the very poor design and the lack of quality materials, it is rendered nearly useless. Each mirror, in and of itself, is nice and clear and seems great. One might think of recycling them, or a young girl may find better use of this vanity mirror as she's playing dress up, or learning to do makeup. For myself, because I cannot see into it with the lights on, as it's meant to be used, and I don't find it aesthetically pleasing to display, I will not be using it.

title: Maniology (formerly bmc) Peel-able Temporary Short Wear Swatching Nail Lacquer Gel Polish Base Coat
all_reviews_text:
After reading the reviews about nail bed damage and how well this helps the soak off I ended up getting it.

Firstly, it does peel a little nail bed up, so the damage thing is accurate. I wouldn't suggest using it "as advertised". However, after nudging off one nail I dis the standard coarse board, polish remover soaked cotton balls, wrap my fingers in foil thing. The soak off is MUCH easier with this as the base coat. They come off faster, more cleanly and leave behind no damage.

I'm only giving it three stars for a few reasons. It doesn't do what it says it should do. It does lift. On my second try, after the first experiment, I did my nails again. Several nails lifted and peeled. Some came completely free with no damage. Usually my gels outlast my level of interest, and I soak them off before I even go the full two weeks. These definitely have a gripping problem. That's not a negative for me. It makes polish changes easier. However, it mean that they don't do what they're supposed to do.

Bottom line, the things about this product that make it convenient for me are counter to what the product is advertised as doing. I imagine that would make it a poor buy for many a gel lover. [SEP] This is a great base coat in general, but I watched tons of videos on how to get this to work and it never did. I tried peeling my manicures off after a shower, after soaking them in warm water (and soapy water), using cuticle oil, etc. nothing worked! [SEP] I had heard some bad things about this base coat but I can only conclude that the people who used it didn't use it correctly. It works really well, no problem pealing off after a couple of hours or a few days. If you don't soak in the bath, like I like to do, you can make it last a week. :-)

Thank you BMC! [SEP] If you try to peel this stuff off, beware. I did and totally messed up my nails.

all_reviews_text:
The shimmers in this palette are fantastic. Very foiled and smooth. Almost like cream. The mattes are ok not the most pigmented but can be built up. They blend well too. The only thing I'm not crazy about is theres only 1 deeper shade (black) other than that its mostly all midtones. Cant really get much of a gradient with this palette alone. I just pull other palettes for deeper shades. [SEP] Love Ucanbe eyeshadows and I love Anwen on YouTube! Great collaboration! [SEP] I love this palette and the looks I've been able to do with it. I don't know the influencer that picked the colors for this, but she did amazing. The mattes are pigmented and the shimmers shine. I've had a ton of fun coming up with looks from this palette. There are enough lighter and neutral colors for you to be able to use for everyday/work ad then spice it up with the more colorful parts for weekend/night. It is the perfect mix for all the time. [SEP] [[VIDEOID:31ec7b4ed456d38f9cf4ffbf48c20839]]
The Good:
Bright and Dark Colors have beautiful color payoff with minimal fall out.
The shimmers/chrome colors are silky smooth and glide on without the need for a “wet” brush.
Wide range of complimentary colors for an endless amount of eye looks.
Affordable.
Cruelty free.
Expiration date clearly labeled on the back of packaging.

The Bad:
Lighter colors are not going to show on all skin tones, but this is not unnecessarily uncommon. I’ve swatches all included colors for reference.

The UGLY:
Be prepared for the palette to be shipped improperly with inadequate packaging. Mine was shipped in an ENVELOPE with one layer of bubble wrap. This allowed some breakage of one of the eyeshadows and while it is repairable...I’ve lost some of the eyeshadow from the pan. However, since this is a packaging issue and not a product issue I am not going to remove any stars.

Verdict:
Another win from UCANBE. I look forward to every product they’ve come out with and I have yet to be disappointed (knock on wood). At this price point you just can’t beat it! [SEP] I love this eyeshadow pallett. It comes with a nice variety of colors. I like how some are matte and some are shimmery. It was packaged nicely and comes with a mirror so it's great to take it on the go.
It blends nicely and lasts all day. I use the "Icy Queen" to put on top of the other colors and it adds the perfect amount of shimmer and looks so pretty. The colors are highly pigmented and overall great quality for the price. [SEP] The eyeshadow palette is pigmented. Will be able to create several different looks. [SEP] Unfortunately I got a defective palette because not one did a few shades arrive broken but the Andreas shade had splotches/discoloration that were definitely not supposed to be there... Of course that was the shade I was most interested in along with redondo and Sardinia. The palette smelled off too. I’ve had Ucanbe palettes before and am not new to makeup having a chemically or factory smell but this was not that. [SEP] The Yes B shade was broken but Anwen said they’re working on reformulating. I just pressed it back in, not a huge deal. All the shades are sooo beautiful. They are so pigmented and blend wonderfully. I purchased it to support Anwen but the palette itself is just wonderful. [SEP] This is a great palette! The colors are amazing! It blends beautifully.

Need a few coats for the black to show up. But the sparkles are plenty. Because of the glitter a little extra effort is needed to remove polish. title: African Black Soap - Face & Body Wash - All Natural Soap for Acne, Eczema, Psoriasis - with Shea Butter and Coconut Oil - 12 OZ by Cleopatra's Choice
all_reviews_text:
I have been using this soap for the last 5 days and wanted to use it that long to see if it works for me. I have sensitive skin on my face that is prone to breakouts no matter how much the company says it is for sensitive skin. I have minor adult acne and still hate it. I just want clear skin...is that not too much to ask? Well, after just 5 days, I see a major improvement around my t-zone and chin area that normally breaks out with everything new I try. I did have one bump that showed up and drew a white head but only lasted a day at the most before it dried up. This is my first time ever using an African black soap and always heard good things about it, and so happy I tried it. This is a really BIG bar of soap that I've cut into smaller pieces so that it last longer. I use it on my arms, legs, and face only. So far, doing wonders. I no longer have dried out skin to where I have to immediately put on lotion after showering. Totally worth trying out, even just once!

I received a free product for the purpose of my review. Opinions are 100% my own. [SEP] Love love love my soap. You get a lot of product and the price is awesome [SEP] I had quite a few people tell me how fantastic this soap is. I am a complete skeptic when it comes to anything that goes on your face. I have the most sensitive skin, everything irritates and burns immediately only to be followed by breakouts. I have used this product for a week now, and LOVE IT! It removes my make up quickly, I swipe once and its gone. It doesn't dry out your skin, but leaves you feeling fresh. I have used it once as a body wash, and it worked great. I also read where you can wash your hair with it, I have tried it once and it left my hair a little dry and to be honest weird feeling. I listed to the review by Renee that suggested cutting this soap bar into much smaller pieces. I probably have 80 pieces all together now, that way your not having to wet the entire soap bar, and you cut down on the waste. I placed them in a sandwich bag (that barely closes). I think this one bar will last me 4 months just washing my face. I am ecstatic, this product could not come at a better time since estee lauder just changed their ingredients and now their make up remover irritates me. Definitely will buy again!! [SEP] I really like this soap. My skin looks good. [SEP] Cleopatra's Choice African Black Soap
I really love this stuff. I was hesitant to buy. After reading other reviews I decided to give it a try it exceeded all of my expectations.
* Leaves your skin feeling very clean and tingly.
*It clears acne every where. I use this soap on both my face and body
*It's a soft soap, kinda hard to handle. I also followed the suggestion to cut the bar in multiple pieces for easier use.
*Storage is simple. Cool dark place. If you decide to cut the bar in smaller pieces, I would store in a plastic container away from an area that stays warmth/heat. My pieced tended to soften, and melt back together.
* I love that it is natural and healthy for your skin. I have sensitive skin and lots of things irritate it. This did not.
* The only think I wasn't fond of was the smell, kinda hard to describe. However that didn't discourage me from continuing to use it. On the bright side, the smell did rinse off when I rinsed the soap off.
* I recommend to anyone on the fence about trying this. It is definitely worth a try. [SEP] Like the way my new soap cleans.

I received this product a few days ago but wanted to use it more than once before writing my review. I also wanted to have my daughter try it as well, because we have two different skin types. I was given the opportunity to try this product as part of a promotional program at a discounted price in exchange for writing an honest and unbiased review. I wanted to insure that the review I gave was accurate - I know that money is hard to come by these days and I wanted to be as accurate as possible when describing the product. It arrived well packaged and in a timely manner. The box holding the tube looked sturdy and professional - it looked like what you would expect from a high quality product. I product dispenses easily and is easy to apply to the skin. It goes on smoothly and evenly, doesn't dry out of make your skin feel tight, and doesn't have a strong or unpleasant odor. My daughter and I tried the mask together - I have very dry skin, along with some fine lines and wrinkles, her skin tends to be oily and she had a few blackheads and larger pores. We left our masks on for 15 minutes and washed them off with warm water. The mask was very easy to remove and left our skin feeling very soft and looking radiant. An additional bonus for me is the fact that mask contains argan, avocado, and jojoba oils. Those added oils left my skin well nourished and moisturized. I applied a light moisturizer because it didn't feel like a heavy one was needed. My daughter was also pleased with the results. She had concerns that the additional oils may cause her skin to break out or leave it feeling oily. The mask washed off her face very easily, her skin felt smooth, her blackheads were gone, and her skin looked radiant. We concluded that this mask is helpful for any skin type and we are planning another mother/daughter spa day soon. We both liked the product and plan on continuing to use it. I can recommend it without hesitation. It's a great product! [SEP] This is the best mask I have tried so far. The texture is strange, it doesn't have the mud texture, but rather a chocolate gelatin pudding texture.
